Chapter 1 · Names and countries

1과 · 저는 나비예요il-gwa · jeo-neun na-bi-ye-yo

I am Nabi.

Today we will learn to:
  • ask someone’s name and say our own,
  • ask what country someone is from and answer,
  • choose -이에요 or -예요.

Warm-up

안녕하세요!an-nyeong-ha-se-yo!

Type in the chat: 안녕하세요! (an-nyeong-ha-se-yo!) + your name in Hangul.

나비
안녕하세요! 나비
an-nyeong-ha-se-yo! na-bi
벨라
안녕하세요! 벨라
an-nyeong-ha-se-yo! bel-la

Warm-up · Hangul reading

Can you read the name?

Presentation · 어휘

나라 · Countriesna-ra

Presentation · 어휘

나라 + 사람na-ra + sa-ram

Put 사람 (sa-ram, person) after a country to say where someone is from.

미국+사람→미국 사람
mi-guk sa-ram
an American

Presentation · 표현

이름이 뭐예요?i-reu-mi mwo-ye-yo? · What is your name?

나비
이름이 뭐예요?
i-reu-mi mwo-ye-yo?
What is your name?
벨라
저는 벨라예요.
jeo-neun bel-la-ye-yo.
I am Bella.

Presentation · 표현

어느 나라 사람이에요?eo-neu na-ra sa-ra-mi-e-yo? · What country are you from?

나비
어느 나라 사람이에요?
eo-neu na-ra sa-ra-mi-e-yo?
What country are you from?
벨라
브라질 사람이에요.
beu-ra-jil sa-ra-mi-e-yo.
I am Brazilian.

Presentation · 문법

-이에요 / -예요-i-e-yo / -ye-yo

받침 O (bottom consonant) → -이에요 (-i-e-yo)
받침 X (no bottom consonant) → -예요 (-ye-yo)

Presentation · 문법

질문 · Questionsjil-mun

Same words. Your voice makes the question.

한국 사람이에요. ↘
han-guk sa-ra-mi-e-yo.
I am Korean.
한국 사람이에요? ↗
han-guk sa-ra-mi-e-yo?
Are you Korean?

Practice · 받침 check

-이에요 or -예요?-i-e-yo or -ye-yo?

Practice · 읽기

대화 2 · 하늘 meets 아론dae-hwa i · ha-neul meets a-ron

아론
한국 사람이에요?
han-guk sa-ra-mi-e-yo?
Are you Korean?
하늘
네, 한국 사람이에요. 어느 나라 사람이에요?
ne, han-guk sa-ra-mi-e-yo. eo-neu na-ra sa-ra-mi-e-yo?
Yes, I am Korean. What country are you from?
아론

jeo-neun mi-guk sa-ra-mi-e-yo.
I am American.
